chart.title: Child mortality
chart.subtitle: The share of children who died in their first five years of life.
chart.note: The reconstructions are mapped into modern country borders. The data is of strongly varying quality across countries and over time. For details see our work on child mortality.
chart.citation: Gapminder (2015); UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (2025)
